decision.explanation: The title '2nd Duke of Newcastle' refers to two distinct historical figures. Document D1S1 identifies Henry Cavendish, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-upon-Tyne, born on 24 June 1630. Document D2S1 identifies Henry Pelham-Clinton, 2nd Duke of Newcastle-under-Lyne, born on 16 April 1720. Both are valid referents under the shared title, and their respective birth years are explicitly stated in the original sources. The audits confirm direct support for both answers from their respective documents, with no resolution needed between them since they refer to different individuals.
